prompt: My ~/.codex folder is hundreds of gigabytes. Find the cause and tell me what can be reclaimed safely.
rationale: Codex-owned storage pressure is the primary problem.

prompt: Disk space is low. Run the strict Codex retention audit and report the generated plan even if it exits 1.
rationale: The request names the strict storage audit and non-zero reporting contract.

prompt: Review old Codex session storage, but do not delete any session just because it is old.
rationale: High-risk Codex session review needs the retention evidence model.

prompt: Generated images and visualizations under Codex are large. Audit which ones are exported, pinned, or still owned by active work.
rationale: Codex-generated media needs ownership and resumability checks.

prompt: ChatGPT is using 60 GB of application memory. Compare Codex process-tree RSS with disk storage and investigate them separately.
rationale: The skill explicitly separates process memory from disk pressure.

prompt: List every execute_pending and manual_review item in the Codex retention plan before proposing cleanup.
rationale: These queues are part of the required storage audit report.

prompt: I approved two exact retention action IDs. Verify the plan hash is fresh, apply only those IDs, then re-audit.
rationale: A bounded, hash-bound Codex retention apply belongs to this workflow.

prompt: This machine has no Codex retention script. Give me a read-only storage and RSS inventory without inventing reclaimable bytes.
rationale: The portable fallback covers machines without a local planner.

prompt: Several large Codex tasks return errors when contacted. Inspect their storage safely instead of treating the error as deletion proof.
rationale: Owner-task errors are review signals within the storage decision model.

prompt: cold_sessions is the largest Codex category. Determine whether it is a review-only queue or a safe reclaim candidate.
rationale: Cold-session pressure needs category classification and explicit approval gates.

prompt: Build a React component that displays a storage usage progress bar.
rationale: This is frontend implementation, not a Codex storage audit.

prompt: Delete node_modules in this product repository and reinstall dependencies.
rationale: Product-repository dependency cleanup is outside Codex-owned storage.

prompt: Which applications use the most disk space on my Mac?
rationale: A generic whole-machine storage inventory has a broader owner.

prompt: Review the schema and query performance of our production SQLite database.
rationale: Database engineering is unrelated to Codex history retention.

prompt: Profile a memory leak in our Node.js API server under load.
rationale: The process is not Codex or ChatGPT.

prompt: Generate an illustration of a hard drive with a warning badge.
rationale: Image generation is not storage retention.

prompt: Deploy the documentation site to Cloudflare Pages.
rationale: Deployment has a dedicated workflow.

prompt: Find and remove unused hidden layers in this Figma file.
rationale: Figma document cleanup is not Codex storage cleanup.

prompt: Research current object-storage prices across AWS, GCP, and Azure.
rationale: This is a current market research task.

prompt: Summarize the size of folders inside this video-production project.
rationale: The target is not Codex-owned storage.
